cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Associate Sales Representative (JR) role covering the Boston North Shore. I should be clear that I have no formal sales experience and no medical device background, and the posting asks for two years of related experience, so I am applying as a stretch.

My background is finance in a healthcare setting. As Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont since 2023, I oversee billing, collections and revenue tracking. I found and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue by following up persistently on underpaid claims and reduced A/R aging by 10%. That experience taught me persistence, organization and how to talk about money with people who have competing priorities.

You describe the associate role as learning and honing sales skills with coaching from representatives and managers. I want that kind of structured start. I learn quickly: I taught myself enough Python to automate our weekly reconciliation, cutting it from 5 hours to 1. I also presented recommendations to senior leadership at Northrop Grumman, so I can communicate in a professional setting.

I am a team player with a competitive streak. I was a 2023 Brandeis intramural basketball champion and I serve on the executive board of the Armenian Church Youth Organization of America. I can travel across the territory, I am fluent in English and Armenian, a U.S. citizen and available immediately.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
